name: E79 Gold Mines Limited
summary: E79 Gold Mines Limited, formerly Zamanco Minerals Limited, explores mainly for gold. Its two key projects are Laverton South, comprising the Lake Yindana and Pinjin tenement packages, and Jungar Flats, covering terrain across two gold-producing greenstone belts in Western Australia's Eastern Goldfields. Established in 2007, it is headquartered in Nedlands.
